note: Different wording still yields the same recognized words. Reuse the same checks; no new blocks are needed.
solution:
POSITION listen
LISTEN
TAKE UP
IF tea IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  ITEM tea
ELSE
  ITEM coffee
END
IF sugar IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
  IF negation IN CUSTOMER SPEECH
    WRITE 0 sugar
  ELSE
    WRITE 1 sugar
  END
END
MOVE RIGHT 1
DEPOSIT RIGHT
MOVE LEFT 1
JUMP listen
